scenes.name: login
scenes.caption: Sign-in overlay — cookie-session auth over the Today screen.
scenes.narration: Sign in — your courses, notes and review schedule are waiting.

scenes.name: today
scenes.caption: Today screen — the daily study dashboard.
scenes.narration: Today greets you with what matters: due reviews, goals and where you left off.

scenes.name: courses
scenes.caption: Courses — the student's course list.
scenes.narration: Every course holds its own tree of chapters, materials, notes and practice.

scenes.name: course-detail
scenes.caption: Course detail — chapters, materials and study actions.
scenes.narration: Open a course to see its structure at a glance.

scenes.name: node-workspace
scenes.caption: Node workspace — the rich-text editor with notes and materials for a chapter.
scenes.narration: The workspace is where studying happens — notes in a rich editor, materials side by side.

scenes.name: library
scenes.caption: Library — every ingested material, searchable.
scenes.narration: The library keeps every ingested document searchable.

scenes.name: material-detail
scenes.caption: Material detail — the extraction view over an ingested document.
scenes.narration: Each material is parsed into a structured extraction you can study from.

scenes.name: review
scenes.caption: Review — FSRS-scheduled flashcards due today.
scenes.narration: Spaced repetition decides what comes back and when.

scenes.name: review-revealed
scenes.caption: Review — a flashcard with the answer revealed and FSRS ratings.
scenes.narration: Reveal, rate — again, hard, good, easy — and the scheduler learns.

scenes.name: chat
scenes.caption: Tutor chat — a demo study answer with math, a recall chart and a flashcard-deck proposal card.
scenes.narration: Ask the tutor for flashcards — the answer arrives with the math, your recall trend and a deck proposal to approve.

scenes.name: scores
scenes.caption: Scores — performance across quizzes, exercises and reviews.
scenes.narration: Scores turn all that effort into a trend you can steer by.

scenes.name: settings
scenes.caption: Settings — profiles, AI providers and preferences.
scenes.narration: Everything is configurable — profiles, AI providers, privacy.

scenes.name: study-session
scenes.caption: Guided study session — the focused flow across review and practice.
scenes.narration: Or let the study session drive — review, practice and recall in one guided loop.
